description: Election Commission - K. Kuneswaran was elected as the member of the Valikamam East Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam East Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority position, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member's absence. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for government bodies.
